title: AnkiCraft
body:
# AnkiCraft

**Client-side Minecraft mod that lets you review Anki cards while you play.**

AnkiCraft connects to AnkiConnect and automatically shows cards on a HUD in-game.

![A screenshot of Anki and Minecraft side by side. An Anki flashcard shows a Japanese word with an example sentence and review buttons.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c68238d7579b1267af6e1f8cccf38e3f2df2b687_0.webp)

### !!DISCLAIMER!!
I only really tested this with my Japanese decks, I can't be sure there isn't formatting issues with other types of decks

---

## Requirements

- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API
- Anki + AnkiConnect
- Mod Menu for settings (optional)

---

## Setup

1. Install Anki + AnkiConnect
2. Open the deck you want to study in anki
2. Launch Minecraft with AnkiCraft installed
3. Open `Mod Menu > AnkiCraft`
4. Refresh decks and pick the deck you want to study

---

## Current Limitations

- Card images are not supported yet
- Does not fully match Anki CSS/styling

---

## Planned Stuff

- Buffs and penalties tied to review results
- Server side reward support 
- UI art
- Localization
- Draggable ui elements
